thread:
Morgan Kim: Morning team — quick coordination for candidate S. Alvarez (final onsite) who arrives 6/12. We need to confirm evening screen timing and who can cover pickup from Union Station.
Lee Wong: I can meet at Union at 5:45pm, should be fine. Do we want to swap the 4pm panel to earlier so interview day doesn't run late?
Tara Nguyen: Swapping would help. I can move my 4:00–4:30 slot to 3:30–4:00 if Anne OKs it.
Anne (recruiter): Candidate prefers no super-early slots; 3:30 start is ok. Also flagged that they need a vegetarian boxed dinner and a single-night hotel stay. I've added dietary note in Greenhouse.
Morgan Kim: Thanks. Can we confirm hotel and taxi? People-ops, can you book a car from Union Station to HQ and back to hotel after the evening screen? Budget: standard rideshare.
people-ops-bot: @Morgan Kim — created a travel request ticket #TR-4821 and assigned to People Ops. ETA: vendor quotes by EOD.
Lee Wong: For the evening screen (6:30–7:15) I'll be host. Do we want this as hybrid? Candidate indicated they can do in-person but might need to drop early.
Tara Nguyen: Yes hybrid would be safer. I'll be remote backup at this link: https://meet.company/redwood-interviews. Please add it to the calendar invite.
Anne (recruiter): Calendar invite updated with both rooms and the Meet link. I removed the 4pm slot and pushed panels earlier: new times attached in invite. Also added a note for the front desk to issue a visitor badge and to leave a parking pass at security (license plate given in candidate profile).
Morgan Kim: Small ask: can someone bring a loaner laptop with Chrome + VPN creds preinstalled? Candidate might want to run a quick repo check.
Lee Wong: I can bring a loaner. I'll leave it on Morgan's desk labeled "S. Alvarez - loaner".
Anne (recruiter): Confirming boxed dinner: vegetarian + gluten-free option noted. Hotel booked: Downtown Inn — one night, check-out 6/13. Confirmation #DI-99321.
people-ops-bot: Travel ticket TR-4821 updated: car confirmed (RideShare Co), driver ETA 5:30pm pickup, cost estimate $42.
Tara Nguyen: One more — candidate requested accessible restroom directions. Front desk will have the map in the visitor packet (added to invite).
Morgan Kim: Great — thanks everyone. If anything slips, @Anne (recruiter) please ping on the day with any last-minute timing changes. :thumbsup:
Anne (recruiter): Will do. Posting final checklist below:
```
- Pickup: Union Station 5:45pm (Lee)
- Host for evening screen: Lee (6:30–7:15)
- Panel times: 9:00, 10:00, 11:30, 2:00, 3:30
- Loaner laptop: Lee (on Morgan desk)
- Hotel: Downtown Inn (DI-99321)
- Dinner: Veg + GF boxed
- Accessibility map: included in invite
- Parking pass: left at security
```
Morgan Kim: Perfect. Closing thread unless a blocker pops up.
